answer: Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. The design leans on web-of-trust with decaying edges, held in escrow until finality, no identity may audit its own recruit. The dawn lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the anchor is where a second reviewer recomputes them. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. By the lantern of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up.
